other.creditedName: 株式会社デジタルハーツ
other.name: 株式会社デジタルハーツ

segments.text: "No… I’m really not accomplished enough to be called a famous detective…"

A boy who learned how to be a detective by watching his uncle. Most of the cases that happen to come to his uncle were small things like investigating infidelity, but on the rare occasion when a murder case came up, he solved it faster than the police. He reached the point where he was recognized as the SHSL Detective.

Saihara, who stands out for his timid speech, demonstrates superior ability and insight. However, because he only happened to solve the murder cases by chance, he doesn’t believe he deserves the SHSL title. Because of a past experience, he doesn't like looking into others' eyes, which is why he hides his face with his cap.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
After Kaede's death, He takes over her role as protagonist for the rest of the game.

Kiyotaka was head of the "public morals committee" at his old high school, a noted college prep school. Although he is from an extremely ordinary family, he has excelled in his student life. His scholastic ability comes from his dedication to working harder than anyone else, and he has no patience for slackers. Even amid the extreme events at Hope's Peak, he maintains a dedication to the school's rules and regulations.
From official description

Byakuya is part of the family in charge of the international mega-conglomerate, the Togami Corporation. As the heir to the family business, he was raised harshly to prepare for his duties. He's full of pride, never bothering to hide his elitist disdain for those around him. He's also the only student trapped in the school who seems to somehow be enjoying their dire situation.
From official description

Mondo is the head of the biggest biker gang in Japan. He likes to refer to himself as a "man of mayhem," but his actions reveal him to be filled with justice and humanity. His professed motto is, "Actions speak louder than everything."
From official description

Leon acted as his high school's cleanup hitter during the national baseball championship tournament. Despite his refusal to ever practice, he's got enough natural talent that pro baseball scouts have already started courting him. He can be kind of obnoxious, but it's hard to hate the guy. Despite his title, he wants to become a musician instead, as he dislikes the restrictions being a baseball player puts on his style.
Edited from Wikipedia & official description

An otaku who is a well-known doujinshi artist. Hifumi has a certain charisma within his industry and is proud of the following he's cultivated. At a local school festival, he was able to sell over 10,000 copies of his latest creation—a stunning achievement by any measure. He proclaims that his interests are solely in the "2D World".
Edited from Wikipedia & official description

Yasuhiro apparently has an inherent ability to predict the future through the use of his own intuition. He claims he's right at least 30% of the time, and that to get it right every single time "isn't fortune-telling—that's just supernatural!" He's been held back a few times because of unspecified woman problems, which makes him the oldest student at Hope's Peak.
From official description

Sayaka is the lead singer in a world-famous idol group. She's the darling of a generation, but she's managed to maintain her sweet, down-to-earth nature. At Hope's Peak, she has a surprising reconnection with Naegi, who was once her classmate a few years ago. But despite spending several years in the same building, they never actually had any direct contact. Still, she becomes the first student at Hope's Peak that Naegi becomes willing to trust.
Edited from official description

Kyoko is the only student at the school whose ultimate ability is totally unknown. She displays a kind of severe beauty, but her past and thoughts are shrouded in mystery. She's reluctant to reveal her feelings, preferring simply to give Naegi hints to push him in the direction of the truth.
Edited from official description

Aoi is a very active, alluring girl who loves sports more than anything. She's a member of almost all of her school's sports teams, but she excels at swimming in particular, breaking a number of high school records. She gets nervous if she sits still for too long, so she's almost always moving around. She's not a particularly deep thinker, but her upbeat enthusiasm helps keep the others positive during their crisis. She loves eating especially donuts but is also self-conscious of her body.
Edited from official description

Toko is a successful novelist known for her stories about fragile young women. Despite being responsible for multiple best-selling romance novels, in person she's very withdrawn and has trouble relating to other people, often coming off as overly negative and hostile.
From official description

Sakura was taught martial arts from a young age by her father, and has become the strongest human being on Earth. They say she learned how to fight before she learned how to walk. Thanks to her stern gaze and taciturn personality, those around her feel intimidated even when she's not doing anything. She is occasionally mistaken for a man due to her muscular appearance and deep voice. She shares a love of physical exertion with Aoi, and they quickly become best friends within the school.
Edited from official description

cast.characterName: セレスティア・ルーデンベルク
cast.originalCharacterName: セレスティア・ルーデンベルク

segments.text: Beneath Celestia's cute lolita-esque appearance lurks a regal beast, with a sharp, wicked tongue. Despite her unusual name, she is in fact from Japan. She's a true genius when it comes to lying, a talent she has applied to the world of gambling. She has sent more than one world-class gambler home broke, and broken. Other than her obvious love of gothic lolita clothes, everything about her is wrapped in a veil of lies.
From official description

Junko is a charismatic model who's graced the covers of all the most popular youth fashion magazines. She has no problem expressing her joy, anger, sadness, or excitement—in fact, one reason she's so popular is because she doesn't seem fake. She's naturally outgoing, and she enjoys teasing the guys around her with her playfully sexy banter.
From official description

Chihiro is a very slight, timid girl that somehow makes you think of a cute little bunny. In fact, she's often mistaken for an elementary school student. She's very quiet, but has an extraordinary ability when it comes to computers.
From official description

Bandai Daisaku is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 11 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in restoring agriculture in disaster areas. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
Junko's twin sister, with the title of "Super High School Level Soldier". She's the "16th student", but takes her sister's identity when the game starts.

cast.characterName: ジェノサイダー 翔
cast.originalCharacterName: ジェノサイダー 翔

segments.text: Genocide Jack is Fukawa Touko's murderous and sadistic alternate personality. She only kills handsome men in the same style: crucifies them with her custom scissors. She has tally-marks carved onto her upper thighs, a count of how many people she has killed.

Genocide Jack's appearance is generally the same as Touko's, since they share the same body. However, some features differ: her eyes become red, and she wears a wild facial expression, with her long tongue being out at all times. Her personality is also much wilder.
Edited from Danganronpa Wikia
"...Well, it’d be faster to play you a song on the piano than express it in words."

The protagonist girl who has grown up with piano all her life. She’s a cheerful, optimistic hardworker with blooming talent, whose friends call her “piano idiot” because she dedicates herself to piano so thoroughly. After winning competition after another, she was given the title of "SHSL Pianist". Being a pianoholic, Kaede tends to include music talk into her conversations. She has the ability to pull everyone together very positively, thanks to her leader-like personality.

Akamatsu feels intense resentment for Headmaster Monokuma, who has forced the students into this outrageous killing game. While encouraging the other students, she strives to get them all out of the school, encouraging them by saying, “Once we get out, we’ll all be friends.”.
Edited from jinjojess's translation

The alter ego of Hajime Hinata, named after the school's founder and very first principal. Izuru was the end product of the Hope Cultivation Plan and as a "genius out of the ordinary", Hope's Peak Academy's ultimate goal, went by the title of Ultimate Hope, and possesses pretty much all of the talents researched in Hope's Peak.

Unlike Hajime, Izuru is a cold and emotionless person who finds everything and everyone boring. He expresses a disgust for talentless people that oppress those with talent instead of acknowledging their "true superiors". He believes that such people brought the world to a deadlock and created a world that has stopped evolving. While he lacks sympathy for others, he differs from Junko in that he neither does not seem to enjoy the sufferings of others. Izuru enjoys unpredictability, which can make him feel more emotional, but he also tends to quickly grow bored because his supernatural analytical skills and intuition cause him to quickly predict things with surprising accuracy.
Edited from Danganronpa Wiki
"I may be a robot but I can read the air! Like I can sense if the air is dirty, or..."

Kiibo is a robot equipped with recording functions and a hyper-advanced artificial intelligence, allowing him to learn and mature like any other teenage human. Raised by his creator Professor Iidabashi as their own child and sent to attend high school, he has been recognized as being SHSL even as a robot.

He has a serious personality and speaks politely, but he gets heated when it comes to discrimination against robots - the so-called "robophobia" - and will not hesitate to call out any and all instances of anti-robot discrimination. As you’d expect of a robot, he has a tendency to to overlook subtle nuances of human interaction, and often makes innocent comments that land him in hot water. Ouma particularly enjoys teasing him over this.
Merged from English official site & jinjojess's translation
"It’s nothing… forget it…"

A girl whose SHSL talent was recognized while she was helping out at an orphanage that raised her at the same time. Because she’s good at taking care of others and despite not being very sociable, children love her. She’s good at caregiving, but she doesn’t even like children, so why do kids like her?

Maki has a cute face but isn’t friendly, and because she dislikes people, she’s pretty uncooperative. Because she doesn’t say much, she’s the type to state things clearly. She isn’t the type to assertively act on her own, but she’s got guts.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
Her title of the Ultimate Nursery School Teacher is just a fabrication to hide her real talent and title, the Ultimate Assassin. She became an assassin in order to save her orphanage.
"Angie just lends her body. The one who actually does it is god. Nyahahaha! Pretty divine, right?"

Believing that the "god of the island" is always at her side, she’s a girl with a pious heart. She can work with drawings, sculptures, and so on, but she’s known to say that "the one who is really creating everything is god." Angie has a positive personality yet does things her own way. She also has the eccentric habit of freely using her own original Japanese, like "byeyonara" or "strange miracle".

She also has a strange side–rather than showing off her pictures, she searches for things to offer as blood sacrifices, proclaims her god’s reasoning on their behalf, and so on. According to Angie, it is a tradition on her island to give some blood - or even larger amounts of it - to their god, and the sacrifice truck, which collects the said blood sacrifices, comes around on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Edited from jinjojess' translation
"Erm… magic exists. I know because… I’m a mage."

Insisting that her parlor tricks are magic, prior to being revised to the SHSL Magician, she was the self-proclaimed SHSL Mage. She claims that she was the youngest person ever chosen by the world magic lovers’ society, The Magician’s Castle, as the Magician of the Year, but she has been prevented from receiving her reward because of a conspiracy to hide the existence of magic. While she isn’t recognized as a mage, she is awash in clients from all over the world who want to hire her as a magician.

Though she's a magician with first class skills, she finds putting in the maximum effort to be too much trouble.. She has high-level sleight of hand techniques and can find someone’s card or coin, or make doves appear, either through illusion or magic. Because she claims to be the SHSL Mage instead, she also speaks like some kind of a real mage from an RPG.
From jinjojess' translation
"Space, ya know, is an ally to people who want to overcome their limits without closing up."

A trainee astronaut. Because becoming an astronaut requires a college degree, he hasn’t even passed the test. Faking his way through his astronaut exams using forged documents, he became the first teen to pass the test but was also found out. Despite this, he was hired on as a trainee for being an interesting, amusing person of talent.

He hasn’t been to space yet, but he harbors a great longing to go. More than anything, he’s an energetic person who believes in dreams and romance, saying such passionate things as “you have no limits if you don’t set them yourself” and “if you don’t take risks, your dreams will stay dreams.”
Edited from jinjojess' translation
"But, that’s not what caught my interest. You said 'killing game' just now…"

A boy whose appearance and manner of speech gives off the impression of being shallow. He is the only one among the students who cannot remember his SHSL talent for some reason, but he isn’t particularly worried about remembering. Instead, he says that he’s looking forward to finding out what his talent is.

Amami is someone who can coldly interrogate Monokuma about his motives. While the others descend into confusion and chaos, he displays a coolness while cross-examining Monokuma and the Monokumarz about their goals, as well as a deep understanding of the current situation. At times, his attitude suggests that he knows more about what's happening than his classmates, which only heightens the air of mystery surrounding him.
Edited from jinjojess's translation

His real talent is the Ultimate Survivor. Having survived the last killing game (V2) as the Ultimate Adventurer, he was once again called to be part of the next killing game, V3. However, his memories of his talent were wiped away before the killing game properly began.
"Hurry up and fuckin’ do it, you raw garbage! It’s wrong to waste even one minute or one second of a genius’s time, ain’t it?"

Centered around the theme of “how can you have such a relaxed lifestyle that it’s like you’re asleep?”, she’s an inventor who creates groundbreaking inventions. She’s made things like the “eyedrop contacts” - which blasted her career through the roof - but she’s also an eccentric who treats her failed projects with the idea that “I transferred the rights to the company, so it’s got nothing to do with me.”

Iruma is someone full of self-confidence, so her speech is brash and harsh. Every time she opens her mouth, it’s just a parade of explosive comments. If someone were to attack her mask, however, she quickly changes into a weakling.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
"Anyway… let me warn you. Don’t come near a killer like me without a reason."

World famous since his middle school days, he was a promising young player who was winning matches abroad, but he killed mafia members by hitting them in the head with his custom-made steel tennis ball. The organization was annihilated, and he became a prisoner on death row known by the name of "Killer Tennis". Because he was incarcerated before coming to Saishuu, he says that the SHSL Tennis Player already is no more.

Although he looks like a child as well, his life experience would put an adult to shame. Thanks to his grand past, Hoshi has a coolness you wouldn’t think a high schooler could possess, and seems as if he wouldn’t be shaken even if he was personally harmed or if someone was killed. Even being shut up in Saishuu Academy and forced into a killing game, he seems unperturbed.
Edited from jinjojess' translation
"…I hope you can understand me. Yes, I love cosplay. Breathing life into a particular character, making the fictional real…"

Tsumugi is a cosplayer so popular that she has a corporate sponsorship. She likes making costumes more than wearing them, but she hates using cosplayers who care more about standing out than love of the series, so she wears her own costumes as well.

Tsumugi is an honor student type who speaks in a docile and gentle way, but she becomes passionate when she talks about her favorite series or cosplays. She also tends to ignore people while she’s thinking, no matter how many times they try talking to her. She also has a habit of quoting famous sayings from various sources, such as manga, anime, books and so on.
Taken from jinjojess's translation
"I have a duty to cooperate with all of my power, since you said we should."

A super high school student with a keen mind and talented in various sports. While working a part time job as a maid, she’s able to carry out any job, and has created a reputation for doing perfect work. In the past, she was even selected as a bodyguard for visiting heads of state. However, she says that of course she turned down the job in order to not ruin a country, according to her words.

Kirumi is a refined, mature young lady. Kirumi’s creed as a maid is “Duty before self.” Even under the extreme condition of being locked inside the Prison School for the Gifted, her will to work for the sake of others doesn’t change, and she takes care of cooking and cleaning for the other students.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
"So… I have an interest in it. I wonder what kind of beauty humans will display under these trying circumstances."

In order to study folklore, he has visited various areas and met with many people. From those experiences, he has formed a pet theory of “humanity’s unlimited beauty”, how humans have “limitless beauty” and even under the trying circumstances of being trapped, he watches his fellow students eagerly to see what kind of beauty they will display. Korekiyo has a creepy appearance, and his fundamental values are a bit off from a normal person’s. He is also a cool, level headed, and intelligent person.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
"No… I’m really not accomplished enough to be called a famous detective…"

A boy who learned how to be a detective by watching his uncle. Most of the cases that happen to come to his uncle were small things like investigating infidelity, but on the rare occasion when a murder case came up, he solved it faster than the police. He reached the point where he was recognized as the SHSL Detective.

Saihara, who stands out for his timid speech, demonstrates superior ability and insight. However, because he only happened to solve the murder cases by chance, he doesn’t believe he deserves the SHSL title. Because of a past experience, he doesn't like looking into others' eyes, which is why he hides his face with his cap.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
"Because I’m an evil supreme leader, I’ve done nothing but bad things so far."

A student who claims to be the “Supreme Leader of a secret society of over 10,000 members.” Because he’s an evil supreme leader, he will unabashedly tell lies and he is also an elusive person who admits to being a liar, says whatever he’s thinking, and will shed crocodile tears. It’s unknown if his secret society actually exists, but the SHSL Detective Shuuichi recalls something about a secret organization, so the matter is shrouded in mystery.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
In reality, his organization, "DICE", has only 10 members in it, and their goal was to pull off "laughable crimes without killing anyone".
"Lies always come from boys first!"

Practitioner of the martial art she somehow or other created with her master, called “Neo Aikido”. A cheerful girl who’s active and wears her heart on her sleeve. Because she yells to unlock her inner potential and has a habit of yelling to show her fighting spirit, she’s an extremely noisy girl.

Tenko hates boys, to the point of calling them "awful boys" (lit. replacing part of the normal word for boys with the kanji for death). However, in the official English release, she calls them "male degenerates". If a boy praises her, her expression dies in an instant. In fact, she thinks that boys are useless and always keep making mistakes. Going beyond just not liking men, if it seems one will touch her, she’ll reflexively throw him. However, if a girl compliments her looks, she’ll respond humorously or modestly.
Edited from jinjojess's translation
"But Gonta won’t give up! A gentleman doesn’t give up that easily!"

Ten years ago, a young Gonta got lost in the woods while searching for insects. It took ten years for him to be returned safely to his family, but in that time he was raised by a family of kind wolves, and he learned to speak with animals and insects, earning him a SHSL title. For the sake of his woodland family, Gonta aims to be a true gentleman. He is normally gentle and genteel, but when the topic of insects comes up, he can suddenly change.

Because he spent his childhood in the forest, he is lacking certain general cultural knowledge, and so he often has trouble speaking with the other students. He can't spot when someone is lying or not either. As his appearance suggests, he has superhuman strength, but he claims that he’s never killed a bug. Also because of his appearance, people have a hard time speaking with him for the first time, so Gonta has a habit of thanking the person for talking with him.
Edited from jinjojess's translation

Monotaro is the leader-esque figure of the Monokubs. Unlike his siblings, he keeps control of their conversations, though he gets sidetracked a lot. Despite being a leader, he is the most clumsy of the siblings, giving him a childlike charm.
From Danganronpa Wiki
"That’s somethin’ Monodam is perfect for! He’s the one who’s had a cheap, ugly-ass body since the start!"
A violent kid with a bad mouth and a short temper. Since he does things like say incoherent stuff without listening to anybody, he’s the main cause of conversations getting derailed.

The most violent of the Monokubs, Monokid habitually bullies Monodam, who should be his comrade, and it’s said that this is why Monodam has closed his heart. By the way, Monokid’s catchphrase is “HELL YEAH!”.
Instead of any kind of Japanese pronoun, Monokid refers to himself using the English word "me".
Edited from jinjojess's translation
One of the Monokumarz said to be Monokuma's children. He’s a cool-headed straightman, with a horrible mouth on him. He speaks in the Kansai dialect.
Often saying “We’re the awkward and unsociable Monokubs!”, he often displays affirmative behavior even in the middle of an argument between members.
Monosuke uses the pronoun "wai" to address himself, which is a Kansai-ben slang version of "washi".
Taken from jinjojess' translation
The lone girl in the group, she has a cute side where she does things like try to solve the killing game via rock-paper-scissors, or suddenly fall asleep.
She isn’t good with gory stuff, and has a gentle side to her. When the Monokubs start their in-fighting she often plays the mediator, but in the end she always ends up joining in the fight.
From jinjojess's translation
The member of the Monokubs who closed his heart because of Monokid’s bullying. For the most part he doesn’t speak to his fellow siblings/members. His unique point is his robotic-looking body.
From jinjojess' translation

Yukizome Chisa is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 5 Director. Her responsibility as the director is the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Munakata Kyousuke is the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Gekkougahara Miaya is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 7 Director. Her responsibility as the director is providing security to deal with cyber threats and development of new ways to cure despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Sakakura Juuzou is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 6 Director. His responsibility as the director is maintaining public order via suppression of insurrection, inquiry regarding special criminals, including the Special Crime Investigation Unit featured in Danganronpa Gaiden: Killer Killer. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Kimura Seiko is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 4 Director. Her responsibility as the director is the research and development of new medical techniques. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Izayoi Sounosuke is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 9 Director. His responsibility as the director is preparation, development, and management of armaments and weapons. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Andou Ruruka is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 8 Director. Her responsibility as the director is assistance in procuring stable food sources. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Kizakura Kouichi is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Mitarai Ryouta is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 10 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in reviving education and culture. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Tengan Kazuo is the founder and chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 1 Director. His responsibility as the director is leadership and deciding the consensus of opinion in the Future Foundation. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

The game's protagonist. Hajime lost all his memories prior to arriving at Jabberwock Island, so he doesn't even remember what his Ultimate talent is. Even when he's in a surreal situation surrounded by murder and mystery, he does his best to stay positive and track down the killer so he and his classmates can survive.

He is actually Izuru Kamukura who is responsible from 13 killings from Hope's Peak Academy. Hajime originally had no talent, entering Hope's Peak Academy as a reserve course student, but he eventually earned the title of Ultimate Hope after participating in Project Izuru Kamukura - a brain alteration/augmentation program named after the school's founder designed to “create a genius out of the ordinary” - in which his original personality were erased.

Even when he's surrounded by despair, Nagito still believes in his friends and the power of hope. Though he seems unreliable, he's always on hand to give Hajime advice and take care of him. Despite his polite demeanor Nagito can be overly harsh at times, but apparently he doesn't mean to come across as rude or insensitive.

Byakuya is part of the family in charge of the international mega-conglomerate, the Togami Corporation. As the heir to the family business, he was raised harshly to prepare for his duties and has already begun managing the business operations. Thus, he possess an overpowering aura of refinement that pushes others away, and his enormous physique only enchances his intimidation factor. Combined with his sizable net worth, it's only fitting that this extraordinary high school student would be known as the Ultimate Affluent Progeny.

As the Ultimate Breeder, there's no animal that Gundam cannot tame. He not only managed to successfully proliferate an endangered species, but it's speculated that he's even capable of holding conversations with animals. His pet hamsters - or The Four Dark Gods of Destruction, as he calls them - can often be seen peeking their eads out from under his scarf, and Gundam sincerely believes that he and his Four Dark Gods of Destruction will one day rule the world.

When it comes to fixing machines, there's no one better than Kazuichi. He prides himself on his flashy appearance and cool demeanor, which makes it all the more surprising that he's actually a coward. Even minor incidents are enough to set him off and send him spiraling into a full-blown panic attack. Given this tendency to freak out at the drop of a hat, it's a mystery how he manages to stay so composed about his crush on Sonia.

The Ultimate Cook likes to pretend he's from the city, but in reality, Teruteru's hometown is in the countryside. His passions include food and sex, and apparently he thinks he has a shot with Peko. Of course, he thinks he has a shot with Sonia too. And with some of the boys as well... At any rate, Teruteru is very happy about being stuck on an island with the other students.

When he is not making innuendos or hitting on someone, he is shown to be decently friendly and relatively upbeat. He takes great pride in his cooking, as shown by his offended reaction during the first trial when it was suggested that Teruteru's cooking had a laxative in it.

Nekomaru Nidai's booming voice is only matched by his powerfully built body. As the Ultimate Team Manager, Nekomaru has visited numerous towns and played an active role managing their teams of various sports clubs. Among his many achievements, he personally led a high school rugby team filled with delinquents to victory in the national playoffs, as well as a baseball club that was on the verge of being shut down. Rumor has it that he's even training a famous young golfer that's been turning heads lately.
Despite his powerful build, Nekomaru suffers from gastrointestinal problems and can often be found behind a locked bathroom door. He has also been often mistaken as a cosplayer due to his appearance.

Fuyuhiko is the heir to the Kuzuryu Clan, the largest organized crime syndicate in the nation with a membership of over 30,000 people. When it comes to the criminal underworld, he's the real deal. Fuyuhiko hates crowds and refuses to get along with anyone, as indicated by his salty attitude and foul mouth.

However, it's possible that he's only acting like that on purpose. Though Fuyuhiko has a youthful appearance, do not under any circumstances comment about his cute, baby-like face. You will run out of fingers before he is finished with you.
Akane Owari is known for being a super athlete. Just by looking at her body, it's hard to believe that she's supposed to be a high school student!

The only things she thinks about are her next meal and her next fight. Despite being the Ultimate Gymnast, Akane has never received any formal training, so her grasp of basic gymnastics is somewhat shaky and her routines are mostly improvised. Regardless, her Ultimate-level athletic prowess is more than enough to make up the difference. When she actually feels like performing, her routines are splendid to behold. But if she's not feeling it, she loses interest and stars switching things up unexpectedly. Because of this tendency of hers, Akane has a reputation for being an unreliable troublemaker.

As the Ultimate Gamer, Chiaki is highly knowledgeable about all genres of video games. She has a tendency to collect her thoughts before she starts speaking, so when she meets someone for the first time, the conversation is rather slow.
Though she's very passionate about video games, if Chiaki gets too comfortable she falls asleep, even in a tense situation where killings are occuring.

cast.characterName: ソニア・ネヴァーマインド
cast.originalCharacterName: ソニア・ネヴァーマインド

segments.text: Sonia Nevermind is a foreign exchange student from a small European country called Novoselic. With her porcelain white skin, sparkling blue eyes, and glittering hair, she exudes a mysterious charm that captivates everyone who sees her. Because of her status as a princess, Sonia has never had friends who match her social standing.

Subsequently, she relishes the opportunity to attend Hope's Peak Academy as a normal teenager to meet people her own age. Though she has a tendency to use slang improperly, her grace and beauty can compel anyone to kneel before without realizing it.
Sonia is also fascinated with serial killers and the occult, and has actually stated that she likes Friday the 13th.
Don't let Hiyoko's childlike appearance and voice fool you; she is definitely a high school student.

Though she's only in the beginning stages of her professional dancing career, the Japanese dance industry already has high hopes for the Ultimate Traditional Dancer. She has already performed overseas numerous times, and her popularity among younger audiences makes her a rarity in the dancing community. Then again, her fans are mostly with "unique" tastes in entertainment, so that may be skewing her popularity somewhat.
Despite her cute appearance, most people are unaware of Hiyoko's capacity for cruelty.

Mahiru has already won several awards for her photography, and has a reputation for her skill at taking photos of people. Though she cares about her friends and is good at taking care of others, though she holds boys to rather high standards. Once she suspects that a boy is unreliable, she starts lecturing him. In fact, as soon as she meets Hajime, she makes a mental note to remember him as "Unreliable Hajime".

As the Ultimate Nurse, Mikan has dedicated her life to helping others. However, her nervousness and complete lack of self-confidence have severely affected her social life. Prior to arriving at Hope's Peak Academy, Mikan had absolutely no friends at all. Because of that, she desperately tries to make everyone happy in hopes that they'll accept her, even when surrounded by death and despair, but she always seems to fail somehow. If you attempt to talk to her, be prepared to discuss one of the 5,000 topics she has prepared in advance...

As the Ultimate Musician, Ibuki was once the lead guitarist in an all-girl band that was super popular among high school girls. After their hit single, "After School Poyoyon Hour" sold over one million copies, Ibuki left the band over creative differences and is currently pursuing a solo career.
Ibuki is a very energetic girl and doesn't care about serious situations at all. Even when she's surrounded by death she often forgets that she's supposed to be worried.
Peko Pekoyama is a kendo master known as the Ultimate Swordswoman. When it comes to swordplay, even grown men don't stand a chance against her.

Despite her cute name, Peko is a stoic, dignified girl with an intense stare that others might find off-putting. She is unfazed by the revelation that she and her classmates are trapped on an island, and decides almost immediately to oppose Monokuma's evil schemes.
Peko is never seen without her bamboo sword. Anyone who tries to mess with her is in for a world of disappointment and pain.

This enlivened stuffed animal can walk and talk and even run a school, as he is the self-proclaimed headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy! The white half of his body is cute and pleasant, while the black half is utterly wicked. He enforces the peace of the school life he's created, or disturbs it, whichever he feels like at that particular moment.
Edited from official description
In New Danganronpa V3, he is the self-proclaimed headmaster of Gifted Inmates Academy and father to the Monokubs as well.

A sentient stuffed rabbit and the lead teacher of the students' school trip. Monomi is sweet, sensitive, and a bit of a crybaby. As the students grow suspicious of each other due to Monokuma's influence, Monomi works hard all by herself to keep their spirits up. For this reason, she's a frequent target of Monokuma's bullying. Furthermore, the students always yell at her whenever she tries to help them.

The hero of our game is a typical high school student with absolutely no remarkable talents or features. Normally, he wouldn't even have a chance at attending Hope's Peak Academy, but thanks to his ultimate talent, he was selected from a lottery among average students across the nation, and was invited to enter the school. His only real merit is that he's a little more upbeat and gung-ho than other kids his age.
From official description
